items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: I’m listening to a lot of Muhal Richard Abrams out of Chicago, the AACM.

ctx.x: I’ll tell you one thing I like about your sound and your improvising is that your articulation is very strong and you never mumble.

Oh I have. And I like the mumblers. I like some of the guys you know but my thing is like again, just try to make the statement, try to be — I have a friend up here, Marty Fogel, he’s the saxophone player that moved up to Vermont. He’s from the New York area. And he played with folks as diverse as like Lou Reed and Don Cherry. But he’s my senior by several years but he tells me, “Tell the truth and tell a story.” Those are his two things. Tell the truth and tell the story. And I like that. I like that. That works…
